BUILD pass 4 — the deferred Hard multi-turn game-tree search, operator overriding the prior 'disproportionate for MVP' call. Built app/src/ai/search.ts: a deterministic best-response plan search (no chance nodes). Movegen = candidate full-turn plans (status-quo first; variants over marketing product × targeting {scored-spread/concentrate-on-best-house/nearest}, expressed as overrides on the one shared heuristic so the engine/AI split + single source of truth hold). Each plan rolled out 2 full turns via the real playTurn; opponents modelled by the Med heuristic, us by the Hard heuristic; only randomness (seeded jitter) → reproducible. Leaf eval = cash advantage (the victory metric; at depth 1 this IS the 1-turn evaluator). Move ordering (depth-1 pass) + iterative deepening + a node budget (deterministic SIM COUNT, not wall-clock) + a branch-and-bound prune; max-only tree vs a fixed opponent model so classic alpha-beta has nothing to prune against (documented honestly, not overclaimed). Runs once per turn at the clean restructuring boundary; plan cached, replayed in the work phase; rollouts call the plain heuristic so the tree never re-enters itself. ai/ai.ts now thin (hard→makeSearchAI, else heuristicPolicy); Low/Med untouched. RESULT (tier-isolated, 50 seeds/matchup, alternating seats, neutral profile): Hard>Low 98→100% · Med>Low 82% · Hard>Med 64→76% — clears the 65% target AND the 70%+ decisive ideal. New tests/sim/search.test.ts (3 cases): within-budget on a representative mid-game state + deterministic; hand-crafted look-ahead scenario where depth-2 picks the concentrate plan a 1-turn evaluator is blind to; that plan strictly dominates the greedy plan at the 2-turn horizon ($60 vs $50) while tying at depth 1 (gap is purely look-ahead). balance.test.ts floors raised 0.80/0.65/0.60 → 0.90/0.70/0.70. Fixed a pre-existing FLAKY campaign e2e (random seed + 50-turn cap, unrelated to the AI) by raising its loop budget to 120 to match the skirmish test; pre-existing gap flagged not fixed (interactive scenarios end on bank break, not on scenario turnLimit). Battery: tsc clean, 67 vitest (+3), sim ladder 100/76/82, 4 Playwright e2e (verified x2), vite build clean (~211kB). Stayed at build gate.
